system.effect:
Requirement: An active compatible modular item with one empty mount.

Sever (EC10)

ACTION • Roll 3+ • USES 2 • RESOURCE 0

Resolution: Equipment + Anima vs Harmony

Range / Targeting: 6 units / Single creature

Effect: On a hit, deal 2 Necrotic Damage. You may also end one temporary beneficial Combat effect currently affecting the target. You must be able to identify the effect; this does not reveal hidden effects. It cannot remove an inherent feature, an equipped item’s continuous property, a Specialty Condition, or a Wound Condition.

Surge 1: Deal +1 Necrotic Damage. Once per use.

Surge 2: Give 1 point of this Damage Breach. Once per use; no additional Damage.

Design note: Ends one existing application, not the source ability. A continuing external aura may reapply according to its own rules.
system.flavor: Harming a target while removing one temporary combat advantage.
